applicabilityBasis.summary: Frax documentation identifies sFRAX at ethereum:0xa663b02cf0a4b149d2ad41910cb81e23e1c41c32 as an ERC-4626 staking vault. Its tokens represent pro-rata deposits, are withdrawable for FRAX at the pro-rata rate and receive weekly distributions of protocol yield. The yield target is expressly not guaranteed. These savings-share rights deliver a variable amount of the underlying digital asset rather than an issuer promise to redeem each share for a fixed amount of monetary value under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: Assessment concerns the sFRAX savings share, separately from the underlying FRAX stablecoin and the distinct sfrxUSD savings product. The primary protocol disclosure identifies a staking vault with pro-rata FRAX redemption and protocol-funded yield, not a separate legal entity promising fixed monetary-value redemption for sFRAX. issuerEntity is omitted. FinresPBC is named as a protocol partner custodian and yield-source participant, not as the issuer of this savings share. No upstream token authorization, reserve report or issuer pathway is attributed to sFRAX. This payment-stablecoin scope assessment does not determine securities classification or the legal treatment of every vault-related service.
